You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

Based on the chest X-ray in Figure 1, which of the following findings best supports the diagnosis of a noncomplicated lung hernia in this patient, considering the clinical history and imaging findings?

A) Presence of a soft tissue mass with air-density structure at the right lung base, continuous with the lung parenchyma.
B) Absence of any air-density structures in the right inferolateral region.
C) Presence of calcified nodules in the right lung field.
D) Soft tissue mass at the left lung base with no air-density structure.
E) Presence of diffuse bilateral lung opacities.
F) A well-circumscribed soft tissue mass without air-density structures on the right side.
